verdict.rationale: Gumroad's llms.txt documents a first-party OAuth + MCP integration. Through it, an AI agent can list sales, draft and edit products, add files and a cover image, publish, and check payouts. That lets a user run core creator workflows with natural-language commands through an agent. The only evidence is this single claimed-docs line. There is no built-in natural-language interface inside Gumroad itself. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, detailed MCP documentation (tool list, setup, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agent-driven operation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
